text: What is the architectural difference between DSL and DOCSIS that produces different complaint patterns?
choices: A DSL line is dedicated to one subscriber; a DOCSIS segment is shared among 100-500 homes, so performance depends on neighbours' usage
explanation: This is why cable subscribers recognise the 'slow at 8 p.m.' complaint and DSL subscribers do not. It is statistical multiplexing with its gains and its visible consequence.
